summary: Multi-agency search-and-recovery op in the Bowl of Tears after a boot was found; boot linked to a subject missing since September 2005; thunderstorms cut the search short with no remains found
location: Bowl of Tears, Mount of the Holy Cross
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group + San Miguel County Sheriff (aviation) + Park County SAR + Search and Rescue Dogs of the United States
notes: San Miguel County Airbus H125 ferried cadaver dog teams (VMRG, Park County SAR, SARDOC US) to an 11,600-ft landing zone; storms rolled in after 2 hours and crews evacuated; the 2005 subject had separated from a hiking partner near the 14,005-ft summit in September 2005 (pre-2010, outside index scope).
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Mount of the Holy Cross)
